use default

distinct_prime_factors(value: int) -> LIST[long] is
    let factors = LIST()
    let remaining mut = value
    let factor mut = 2

    while factor * factor <= remaining do
        if remaining % factor == 0 then
            factors.add(cast long(factor))

            while remaining % factor == 0 do
                remaining = remaining / factor
            od
        fi

        factor = factor + 1
    od

    if remaining > 1 then
        factors.add(cast long(remaining))
    fi

    factors
si

is_giuga(value: int) -> bool is
    let factors = distinct_prime_factors(value)

    if factors.count < 2 then return false fi

    let total = cast long(value)

    factors |> all(factor => (total / factor - 1L) % factor == 0L)
si

giugas() -> Pipe[int] is
    let candidate mut = 1

    do
        candidate = candidate + 1

        if is_giuga(candidate) then
            yield candidate
        fi
    od
si

write_line("the first four Giuga numbers:")

for value in giugas() |> take(4) do
    write_line("  {value}")
od
